Name: Powerful Foods
Author: SUCUMBAAA
Description:
This content pack makes use of 'Persistent buffs' framework to give strengthened buffs to food that didn't have,  and they last longer . Not all food in the game were changed because some limitations. Some chosen foods already had buffs, so i change them to be more accurate to their proposals.

This is a QoL cheat mod made for people that want to enjoy other contents than focus on skill grinding, but can make your time grinding more fun i promisse! Here a list with the changes:
